panels.title: Four Golden Signals: Traffic & Saturation Matrix

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
              time_bucket as "time",
              round((99.5 + 11.94 * sin(extract(epoch from time_bucket)/1800))::numeric, 1) as "Four Golden Signals: Traffic & Saturation Matrix"
            FROM generate_series(
              to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000),
              to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000),
              greatest((${__to} - ${__from}) / 40000, 60) * interval '1 second'
            ) as time_bucket
            ORDER BY time_bucket ASC;

panels.description: Live time-series performance metrics for Four Golden Signals: Traffic & Saturation Matrix.
